Public Alert – Beware of Misleading Insurance Sales Practices

I want to share my personal experience to protect others. Some employees here mislead customers into surrendering old policies and purchasing new ones under the promise of “3-year guaranteed returns” (like Amit giri). They trap you always confirm all the term and condition from policy document online always beacuse they will make a edit and show you as well.

🚫 Fact: There is no IRDAI-approved 3-year guaranteed return plan. If you stop paying after 3 years, your policy may become Reduced Paid-Up, causing big financial losses.

💡 Advice:

Always demand official brochures

Verify the plan on the IRDAI website

Do not trust only verbal promises

This review is only to make people aware and save hard-earned money from misleading sales pitches.

#ConsumerAwareness #InsuranceAlert

featured_reviews.name: Summit Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have a health insurance policy with ICICI Lombard General Insurance. The policy covers cashless hospitalization, emergency ambulance, faster claim process and many more great benefits. There renewal process is also smooth. The Fort branch is located near my office area and the staff over here are quite polite and supportive.

featured_reviews.name: Niloufer Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I like the quick method your team have implemented for renewal of my car insurance policy. There are user friendly people around, the service is satisfactory with scope of improvement. My car had an accident to get repaired and I called and register the claim for cashless garage benefit. My overall experience was smooth and nice.

featured_reviews.name: saurabh mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: I got to know about ICICI Lombard from my friend. I logged on to their website to buy travel insurance plan for my trip to Malaysia. The process was simple, and I could purchase the policy within few minutes. Also, I quickly got the soft copy in my email. This made me have a worry-free trip.

featured_reviews.name: Moolaram Mundliya
featured_reviews.review_text: Purchasing international travel insurance from ICICI Lombard was a really good decision. When I got hospitalized abroad it helped me get through my problems without a hassle. Now I advise everyone to get insured before travelling overseas.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a scooty rider and I often take my Aprilia SR 150 mostly out of Bombay as well. Recently my two wheeler insurance policy got expired and I decided to renew it from ICICI Lombard. I visited the Fort branch and a executive person explained me everything in detail about the plan and I also like their facility of cashless claim settlement across 2150 plus preferred garage across the county which is good benefit for me.

featured_reviews.name: Smartanil Sumra
featured_reviews.review_text: I did not have to use my travel insurance plan, so I cannot rate how the claim process is. But, the peace of mind having my very own travel insurance for a 7-night cruise in Singapore was worth the cost. Comparing this plan to other travel insurance companies, it provided me good coverage for a reasonable price.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Bansal
featured_reviews.review_text: Customer service of ICICI Lombard Fort Branch is very good. I recently purchased a top up plan - health insurance from this branch and I must tell you that the service facilities are good and specially it's on time. I am quite happy with the customer service of ICICI Lombard.

featured_reviews.name: Aaina Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: There are many companies selling car insurance. However, the best car insurance cost is provided by ICICI Lombard. The policy is really easy on the pockets, and the claim process is very simple.
